scoring.rule: One point per item answered with its risk answer: 'yes' for items 2, 5 and 12, 'no' for all other items.

follow_up.description: Only the items that scored a point are followed up. An item still showing the concern after its follow-up questions counts as a fail.

result_copy.low: Your answers do not show strong signs of a developmental concern right now. If your child is younger than 2, do this check-in again after their second birthday. This is a developmental check-in, not a diagnosis.
result_copy.moderate: Some of your answers are worth a closer look. A few follow-up questions can help, and a professional can check your child's development. This is a developmental check-in, not a diagnosis.
result_copy.high: Your answers suggest your child should see a developmental professional soon for an evaluation. This is a developmental check-in, not a diagnosis.
result_copy.follow_up_negative: After the follow-up questions, your answers do not show strong signs of a developmental concern right now. Keep watching your child's development and talk to your child's doctor at regular check-ups. This is a developmental check-in, not a diagnosis.
result_copy.follow_up_positive: After the follow-up questions, your answers suggest your child should see a developmental professional for an evaluation. This is a developmental check-in, not a diagnosis.
